summary: CCC-built 79-ft 6-in steel fire tower in Nash County, erected March 1935; a 1964 notice still calls it the Swift Creek Fire Tower. Fate and site today not described.

notes_for_editor: One source: the Forest Lookouts North Carolina list, which cites the state's 1934-36 biennial report and a 1964 Rocky Mount Evening Telegram item. No NGS datasheet (tnlandforms gives no designation). Nothing read describes the tower's status, staffing after 1964, or the site today, so the story says so. Record coordinates (36.10138, -77.89916) were not checked against any source. Two leads were seen in search results but not used: a 2026 EXIT Realty listing for a lot on Fire Tower Farm Road in Whitakers uses the name Swift Creek Fire Tower for the area and does not describe a tower; a MapQuest business listing calls it a historic lookout tower in Whitakers offering views, but its page text could not be read and the claim looks auto-generated. Worth a field or local check before any status line is published. Access left unset: no source says whether the site can be visited.
